id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25b0: "Hey, you! Don't tell me you're going to Gallopolis!?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|263c: "Can't you see that falling star!? Going to a dangerous place like that is madness!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2728: "I see... Well, of course. No fool would go out of their way to where a star is falling.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2848: "When the Luminary's Star shattered, I resigned myself to my life ending, but I seem to have survived somehow...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2938: "A narrow escape indeed. I must live to the fullest so as not to waste this life I saved.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b68: "Beyond here is Laguna di Gondolia, but... there's no use running anywhere. Before that black sun we're powerless.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3adc: "Well, I was at this checkpoint, so I'm no one to talk. I'm amazed I survived, really.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4364: "Is that also the work of the Dark One, rumored to have descended upon the world after destroying the tree...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|445c: "Breaking before the star hit the ground... I never imagined such an ending, yet strangely I'm not surprised.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4530: "Since Yggdrasil fell, strange things have happened worldwide, so maybe my senses are numb.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4638: "The Dark One has finally been defeated. Monsters will gradually dwindle and we'll be able to travel safely.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|4758: "When the Luminary's Star fell, a violent sandstorm I'd never experienced arose. I thought I was done for.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|485c: "And then that black sun appeared... Even now I can't believe I'm alive.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6788: "I was a bit disappointed in the prince over the Deathscorpion incident, but the prince now is something.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6854: "Dealing with you must have helped him grow. As a citizen of Gallopolis, I must thank you. Thanks.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|6968: "When the Luminary's Star suddenly lit up and fell faster, I thought it was over for sure.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|75b4: "Yggdrasil, the source of all life, and the Luminary's Star of old said to watch over Erdrea...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7684: "If these two are lost, Erdrea can only perish... It's over. It's the end...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7774: "That the Luminary's Star luckily broke just before hitting the ground is hard to believe. Something must have happened.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7860: "You were at the Bakraba Stones, weren't you? If you saw anything there, would you tell me?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|79b0: "...Y-you're joking, right? A star that huge being cut, that can't possibly be...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7a9c: "I see. You saw nothing. I hoped you might have seen something. That's a pity...
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7bb8: "I was studying the Bakraba Stones' link to the Luminary's Star, and these pillars bear strange patterns and ancient letters.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|7cd4: "Perhaps these patterns relate to the star's fall. I'll look into it in detail.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bfa4: "...Still, what a sight. Chances to view the Luminary's Star this close are rare.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c068: "{var:1}, since you're here, stand in the middle of the ruins and look. It's spectacular.

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c218: "If you like, {var:1}, tell Father what you saw at the Celestial Sands!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c324: "Cutting a giant star in one stroke, that Savior was amazing. I've never seen anyone so cool.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c410: "That's it, {var:1}! If you mean to defeat the Dark One, you should team up with him!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c4b4: "If you and the Savior team up, the Dark One will fall in one blow. Come on, {var:1}, do it!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c5a8: "Everyone, listen! When the Luminary's Star fell, a Savior appeared from nowhere and cut that star in two!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cd40: "Everyone, listen! When the Luminary's Star fell, a Savior appeared from nowhere and cut that star in two!
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c6c0: "Gallopolis was saved entirely thanks to that Savior! Everyone, give him thanks!

id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c840: "That hammer holds a spirit's power and can forge any metal, they say. Please use it on your adventure.
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c96c: "By the way, {var:1}, I think the Savior is the one who cut the Luminary's Star. What do you think?
id./param/region/r006.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ca54: "Right. Nobody but the Savior would bother doing that. I'm glad you agree with me.

tm.「おい お前！\n まさか サマディー王国に 行くつもりか！？: "Hey, you! Don't tell me you're going to Gallopolis!?
tm.「あの 落ちてくる星が 見えないのか！？\n わざわざ 危険な場所に 行くなんて: "Can't you see that falling star!? Going to a dangerous place like that is madness!
tm.「そうか……まあ そうだろうな。\n わざわざ 星が落ちてくる場所に\n 好んで: "I see... Well, of course. No fool would go out of their way to where a star is falling.
tm.「勇者の星が 砕け散ったときは\n ついに 私の人生も 終わりかと覚悟したが\n: "When the Luminary's Star shattered, I resigned myself to my life ending, but I seem to have survived somehow...
tm.「九死に一生とは まさに このこと。\n せっかく助かった この命を ムダにしな: "A narrow escape indeed. I must live to the fullest so as not to waste this life I saved.
tm.「ついに 勇者が 魔王を倒したらしい。\n 我々サマディー兵士も あきらめずに\: "The hero has finally defeated the Dark One, it seems. We Gallopolis soldiers kept fighting the Dark One's army for this...
tm.「これより先は ダーハラ湿原だが……\n どこへ逃げても ムダだと思うぞ。\n: "Beyond here is Laguna di Gondolia, but... there's no use running anywhere. Before that black sun we're powerless.
tm.「この学者さん 勇者の星が落ちはじめてから\n ブツブツと ひとりごとを言ってて: "This scholar has been mumbling to himself since the Luminary's Star began to fall. Something's off with him.
tm.「あの得体の知れない物体が 壊れるとき\n 真っ二つに割れたように 見えたが\n: "When that unknown object broke, it looked like it split cleanly in two, but was that my imagination...
tm.「命の大樹が 復活したそうだな。\n これで ロトゼタシアに\n 命の恵みが よ: "I hear Yggdrasil has revived. Now Erdrea will regain the blessings of life.
tm.「この学者さん 勇者の星が落ちたのを\n 目の前で 見ていたみたいなんだ。\n: "This scholar apparently saw the Luminary's Star fall right before his eyes. Amazing he survived...
tm.「ま この関所にいた俺も\n 他人のことを とやかく言える柄じゃないがな。\n: "Well, I was at this checkpoint, so I'm no one to talk. I'm amazed I survived, really.
tm.「サマディー地方は 命の大樹が落ちた影響を\n 運良く受けなかったのですが\n: "The Gallopolis region was luckily spared by Yggdrasil's fall, but I never imagined a star would fall from the sky...
tm.「やはり あれも 大樹を滅ぼし\n 世界に降臨したと ウワサされる\n 魔王のし: "Is that also the work of the Dark One, rumored to have descended upon the world after destroying the tree...
tm.「星が 地上に落ちる前に 壊れるとはね。\n こんな結末は 思ってもみなかったけ: "Breaking before the star hit the ground... I never imagined such an ending, yet strangely I'm not surprised.
tm.「命の大樹が 落ちてからというもの\n 世界中で 異常事態が 起きているから\n: "Since Yggdrasil fell, strange things have happened worldwide, so maybe my senses are numb.
tm.「とうとう 魔王が倒されたとのことです。\n やがて 魔物の数も少なくなっていき: "The Dark One has finally been defeated. Monsters will gradually dwindle and we'll be able to travel safely.
tm.「勇者の星が 落ちてきた時\n 体験したことない 猛烈な砂嵐が起きましてね。\n: "When the Luminary's Star fell, a violent sandstorm I'd never experienced arose. I thought I was done for.
tm.「それに加え あの黒い太陽が あらわれて…。\n いやー こうして 無事に生きて: "And then that black sun appeared... Even now I can't believe I'm alive.
tm.「空から 巨大な星が落ちてくるなんて\n もう 悪い夢としか 思えないぜ……。: "A giant star falling from the sky... I can only think it's a bad dream...
tm.「今となっては 砂漠の殺し屋 デスコピオンを\n こわがっていたのが なつかしい: "Now, fearing the desert killer Deathscorpion seems nostalgic. Compared to that star, he was adorable.
tm.「砂漠の殺し屋 デスコピオンの一件では\n 王子に すこし失望したが\n 今の王: "I was a bit disappointed in the prince over the Deathscorpion incident, but the prince now is something.
tm.「あんたと交流する中で 成長したんだろう。\n サマディーの国民として あんたに: "Dealing with you must have helped him grow. As a citizen of Gallopolis, I must thank you. Thanks.
tm.「勇者の星が 突然 光りだして\n 落下するスピードが 速くなっただろ？\n あ: "When the Luminary's Star suddenly lit up and fell faster, I thought it was over for sure.
tm.「ホントに 今でも こうして\n 生きてることが 信じられないな……。: "Truly, I still can't believe I'm alive like this...
tm.「魔王の軍勢が この辺りを襲い\n 死を覚悟したが なんとか生き残れたよ。\n: "The Dark One's army attacked this area and I prepared to die, but I somehow survived. I can't believe I'm alive...
tm.「あの黒い太陽……\n 地獄の底から出てきたみたいで 不気味だよ。\n まるで: "That black sun... It's eerie, like it came from the depths of hell. Like a nightmare.
tm.「砂漠の殺し屋を こわがってたのが\n 今となっては なつかしいよ。\n 黒い太: "Fearing the desert killer seems nostalgic now. Compared to the black sun, he was adorable.
tm.「あらゆる生命の みなもとである命の大樹と\n ロトゼタシアを見守ると伝えられて: "Yggdrasil, the source of all life, and the Luminary's Star of old said to watch over Erdrea...
tm.「この ふたつが失われれば\n ロトゼタシアは 滅びるしかない……。\n もう: "If these two are lost, Erdrea can only perish... It's over. It's the end...
tm.「勇者の星が 地上に落ちる寸前に\n 運よく 壊れるなんて 信じられません。\n: "That the Luminary's Star luckily broke just before hitting the ground is hard to believe. Something must have happened.
tm.「あなたは バクラバ石群にいたのでしょう？\n もし あそこで 何か見たのであれ: "You were at the Bakraba Stones, weren't you? If you saw anything there, would you tell me?
tm.「……じょっ 冗談ですよね？\n だって あんな巨大な星が斬られるなんて\n そ: "...Y-you're joking, right? A star that huge being cut, that can't possibly be...
tm.「そうですか。何も 見ませんでしたか。\n もし 何か見ていればと思ったのですが: "I see. You saw nothing. I hoped you might have seen something. That's a pity...
tm.「バクラバ石群と 勇者の星の関連を\n 調べていたのですが よく見ると この石柱: "I was studying the Bakraba Stones' link to the Luminary's Star, and these pillars bear strange patterns and ancient letters.
tm.「もしかしたら この模様が\n 勇者の星の落下に 関係があるかもしれません。\n: "Perhaps these patterns relate to the star's fall. I'll look into it in detail.
tm.「み 見てしまったんだ……。\n 勇者の星が この地に落ちた時……\n 中から: "I-I saw it... When the Luminary's Star fell here... a giant monster emerged from inside...
tm.「あんな まがまがしいバケモノは\n 見たことがない……。もう この世は終わりだ: "I've never seen such a vile monster... The world is over. Erdrea is finished...
tm.「……しかし すごい迫力だな。\n こんなに間近で 勇者の星を\n ながめられる: "...Still, what a sight. Chances to view the Luminary's Star this close are rare.
tm.「{var:1}さんも せっかくだから\n 遺跡の真ん中に立って ながめていくと: "{var:1}, since you're here, stand in the middle of the ruins and look. It's spectacular.
tm.「ああっ {var:1}さん！\n ちょうど今 父上に\n 救世主さまのことを話: "Oh, {var:1}! I was just telling Father about the Savior!
tm.「よかったら {var:1}さんも\n バクラバ砂丘で 目撃したことを\n 父上: "If you like, {var:1}, tell Father what you saw at the Celestial Sands!
tm.「巨大な星を 一刀両断にするなんて\n あの救世主さまは すごかったな。\n あ: "Cutting a giant star in one stroke, that Savior was amazing. I've never seen anyone so cool.
tm.「そうだ {var:1}さん！\n 魔王を倒すつもりなら\n 彼と協力したほうが: "That's it, {var:1}! If you mean to defeat the Dark One, you should team up with him!
tm.「{var:1}さんと 救世主さまが組んだら\n きっと魔王なんて イチコロさ。: "If you and the Savior team up, the Dark One will fall in one blow. Come on, {var:1}, do it!
tm.「皆の者 聞いてくれ！ 勇者の星が落ちたとき\n どこからともなく現れた 救世主: "Everyone, listen! When the Luminary's Star fell, a Savior appeared from nowhere and cut that star in two!
tm.「サマディーが 救われたのは\n すべて あの救世主さまのおかげだ！\n さあ: "Gallopolis was saved entirely thanks to that Savior! Everyone, give him thanks!
tm.「あのハンマーには 精霊のチカラが宿っていて\n どんな金属でも 鍛えあげられる: "That hammer holds a spirit's power and can forge any metal, they say. Please use it on your adventure.
tm.「そういえば {var:1}さん。\n ボクは 勇者の星を斬ったのは\n 救世主: "By the way, {var:1}, I think the Savior is the one who cut the Luminary's Star. What do you think?
tm.「そうだよな。救世主さまじゃなければ\n わざわざ あんなことしないもんな。\n: "Right. Nobody but the Savior would bother doing that. I'm glad you agree with me.
